nakzali.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
mythicDifferences: Invoke : Nek'zali beckons for Ula'tek, invoking the Soulcoil Rite as the well reverberates her call, instructing several Latent Cultist s to begin Entwined Step . On Mythic Difficulty, interrupts all spell casts and silences interrupting players for 2 sec. (Mythic)

vashnik.name: Vashnik the Malignant
mythicDifferences: Imbibe : Vashnik draws power from two fountains, causing a living venom to erupt forward, and granting a stack of Toxic Vapor . On Mythic difficulty, Imbibe additonally draws Malignant Tumors from the fountains
Plague Wave : Waves of plague venom erupt from a unit, inflicting 615772 Plague damage to all players hit. On Mythic difficulty, Plague Waves remove Hardened Tumor from Malignant Tumors

bargained.name: The Coiled Altar
mythicDifferences: Manifestation of Dread : A terrifying being manifests, fixating on a random player. On Mythic difficulty, Manifestations of Dread can only be seen by the target they are fixating

Spirit Erasure : The fragment is violently erased from existence when stepped on, inflicting 192429 Shadow damage to all players. The fragment attempts to drag down its desecrator, increasing their damage taken from Spirit Erasure by 20 % for 5 sec. This effect stacks. On Mythic difficulty, stepping on a fragment increases damage taken from Spirit Erasure by 20 % for 5 sec

ulatek.name: Ula'tek
mythicDifferences: Devourer's Spawn : The endless spawn of Ula'tek. These hardened eggs go through rapid gestation and hatch the creatures within whenever they come into contact with the venom that fills Ula'tek's prison. On Mythic difficulty, Devourer's Spawn are and cast on players that pick them up
Doomscale Egg : On Mythic difficulty, Doomscale Eggs use on all remaining Devourer's Spawn on their side

Volatile Purge : Ula'tek's venom inflicts 53880 Nature damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. On expiration, the poison erupts from the affected players inflicting 75 Nature damage to players within 7 yards of the purge. On Mythic difficulty, waves erupt from the player when their aura expires. (Mythic)
Frost Barrage : Nymrissa hurls icy volleys at players, inflicting 18 Frost damage every 1sec. On Mythic difficulty, Lingering Frost can be remove by Water Jet . (Heroic)
Lingering Frost : Inflicting 23101 Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide. On Mythic difficulty, Lingering Frost can be remove by Water Jet

Water Jet : Nymrissa condenses surrounding water into a high-pressure jet, blasting her target for 40 Frost damage every 1 sec and gradually pushing affected players away. The surging water washes away icy patches on the ground. The power of water increases damage taken from Water Jet by 45 % and Frost damage taken by 15 % for 40 sec. On Mythic difficulty, ice ground can be removed by Water Jet
Ritual Venom : Dormant toxins fill the player for 45 sec. Upon expiration, the venom bursts inflicting 40 Nature damage. On Mythic difficulty, this effect stacks. (Mythic+, Mythic)

Bedrock Slam : Meittik strikes their primary target with immense force, inflicting 20 Nature damage and 449313 Physical damage. The force of the impact ruptures nearby topsoil, creating patches of Fertile Loam . On Mythic difficulty, Bedrock Slam causes a Bedrock Surge. (Mythic+, Mythic)

Thornblade : Lekshi ambushes a player and backstabs them, inflicting 10 Nature damage and causing them to bleed for 4 Physical damage every 2 sec for 8 sec. On Mythic difficulty, Lekshi casts Fan Of Thorns immediately after impaling their target. (Mythic+, Mythic)

Verdant Stomp : Ikuzz stomps, inflicting 134794 Physical damage to all players and knocking them back. After 4 sec, Bloodthorn Roots emerge at players' locations. On Mythic difficulty, Bloodthorn Roots emerge at players' locations after Verdant Stomp. (Mythic+, Mythic)

Burnout : When its health is depleted, the Blazebound Firestorm goes out with a bang, inflicting 449313 Fire damage to players within 20 yards. On Mythic difficulty, this ability leaves behind Scorched Earth. (Heroic, Mythic+, Mythic)

Molten Boulder : Kokia slams a molten boulder into the ground in front of her, inflicting 30 Fire damage to players within 6 yards. Any player it touches takes 269588 Fire damage and gets knocked back. The boulder rolls forward up to 40 yards and then explodes, inflicting 60 damage to players within 12 yards. On Mythic difficulty, this ability leaves behind Scorched Earth

Stormslam : Erkhart delivers a massive blow to a player, inflicting 359451 Physical damage and 16 Nature damage , and additionally increasing Nature damage taken by 100 % for 30 sec. This effect stacks. On Mythic difficulty additionally applies a vulnerability to targets. (Mythic+, Mythic)

Tempest Winds : Aspix targets players with furious winds that build over time. These winds coalesce into tempest zones, inflicting 197698 Nature damage and knocking back any players struck. On Mythic difficulty, Aspix targets two players with Tempest Winds

Invoke : Nek'zali beckons for Ula'tek, invoking the Soulcoil Rite as the well reverberates her call, instructing several Latent Cultist s to begin Entwined Step . On Mythic Difficulty, interrupts all spell casts and silences interrupting players for 2 sec. (Mythic)
